# Dealer Agent Protocol
> Open MCP standard for car dealership inventory, availability, and pricing disclosure. Apache-2.0. A public Gateway pilot serves dealer-authorized inventory from a Buick GMC dealer in Alabama with explicit uncertainty and verification requirements.

Dealer Agent Protocol (DAP) covers dealer and rooftop identity, published vehicle inventory, authoritative availability, advertised prices, required dealer charges, discounts, incentives, provenance, freshness, uncertainty, a separately claimed consented handoff, and a provider-neutral used-vehicle profile for mileage, inventory tenure, history, title, inspection, certification, warranty, reconditioning, and source conflicts.

DAP is not Auto Agent Protocol (AAP). AAP is an A2A automotive profile. DAP is MCP-native and publishes an optional A2A extension and bridge.

Dealer Agent Protocol is the open specification and conformance contract. Dealer Agent Gateway is open reference software that implements the protocol. MCP is the transport used between agents and gateways.

## Public demo gateway (synthetic data)

- Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, or Cursor: https://dealeragentprotocol.com/try/
- MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in): https://demo.dealeragentprotocol.com/mcp
- Manifest: https://demo.dealeragentprotocol.com/manifest.json
- Static discovery example: https://demo.dealeragentprotocol.com/.well-known/dealer-agent.json
- CSV feed example: https://demo.dealeragentprotocol.com/feeds/inventory.csv
- Consent binding keys: https://demo.dealeragentprotocol.com/.well-known/jwks.json
- Policy: https://demo.dealeragentprotocol.com/policy
- Data status: synthetic Example Motors Group fleet; every profile including consented handoff; nothing is delivered to a dealership

## Public Gateway endpoint

- Gateway platform status: https://mcp.dealeragentgateway.com/status
- Pilot dealer (a Buick GMC dealer in Alabama) Streamable HTTP: https://mcp.dealeragentgateway.com/dealers/howard-bentley/mcp
- Pilot dealer health: https://mcp.dealeragentgateway.com/dealers/howard-bentley/health
- Pilot dealer policy: https://mcp.dealeragentgateway.com/dealers/howard-bentley/policy
- Pilot dealer conformance status: https://mcp.dealeragentgateway.com/dealers/howard-bentley/conformance
- Data status: dealer-authorized daily retail feed from a Buick GMC dealer in Alabama; live price and availability verification required

Specification text, schemas, examples, conformance tests, and reference code are available under Apache License 2.0.

Dealer Agent Protocol was created by Ariel Coro. DealershipMCP is a Dealer Growth Hackers product and one implementation of the open standard.
